# anthropic_spend_limit (Resource)

Manages a member's spend limit override in a Claude Enterprise organization through the Spend Limits API.

The Spend Limits API is available to Claude Enterprise organizations with usage
credits turned on. The API key needs the `read:spend_limits` and
`write:spend_limits` scopes.

The API identifies a limit by its user and period, and setting a limit that already
exists overwrites it in place. Creating this resource therefore adopts any
override the member already has for the period, and destroying it deletes the
override. The member then falls back to the seat tier, group or organization
default for the period, or to no limit. Those defaults are configured in
claude.ai and are not available through the API. Manage each user and period
pair with one resource only.

Setting a limit does not resolve a pending increase request. Use the
`anthropic_effective_spend_limits` data source to see the limit each
member resolves and where it is inherited from.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Amounts are in the minor unit of the organization's billing currency.
# For USD, "50000" is $500.00.
resource "anthropic_spend_limit" "analyst" {
  user_id = "user_01WCz1FkmYMm4gnmykNKUu3Q"
  period  = "monthly"
  amount  = "50000"
}

# Without an amount, the member has an explicit no-limit override for the
# period instead of the seat tier, group or organization default.
resource "anthropic_spend_limit" "lead" {
  user_id = "user_01Ab6sXyLd3sWnTgPK2bA9zD"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `user_id` (String) Tagged ID of the member the limit applies to (`user_...`).

### Optional

- `amount` (String) The cap on spend within each period, as a non-negative integer decimal string in the minor unit of the organization's billing currency (cents for USD): `"50000"` is $500.00. Leave it unset to set an explicit no-limit override for the period, which differs from having no override at all.
- `period` (String) Length of the window the limit resets over. The API documents `daily`, `weekly` and `monthly`, and currently supports only `monthly`. The API applies its default when this is not set.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of when the spend limit was created.
- `currency` (String) ISO 4217 code of the organization's billing currency, the unit of `amount`.
- `id` (String) ID of the spend limit (`spl_...`).
- `updated_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of the last change to the spend limit.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import anthropic_spend_limit.analyst spl_01HrxLqc8rN2Mp5vT3wB6hKe
```
